svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Mockup 19 (plan): an order's money
svg.text: 19 · An order's money, for the holder: even shares or exact amounts, who owes what (holder, phone)
New for the plan (M1, M2, D7 B, U12 note): the platform works out each person's amount; no money moves through it.
A · Even shares, paid via the organiser

g.text: People pay the organiser after the event.
Nothing to collect at the door.

svg.text: B · Exact amounts, paid to the holder

g.text: Each person owes you their amount;

svg.text: C · Who owes you

g.text: A tick is your memo: no money moves
through the app. Each person sees only

svg.text: D · A pizza without a price
Exact, or even
Exact when every pizza has a price, from the menu
(D7 B) or the confirmed receipt (M3): each
person's prices plus their part of the extras,
split per pizza. Otherwise even shares: the total
divided by the pizzas, as the payment system does
it (M2). The holder may choose even at any time.
Amounts add up
Amounts are rounded to the cent so that they add
up to the total exactly; the leftover cents go to
the largest remainders.
Who is paid (M1, U12 note)
"Me directly" appears only when the event allows
holders to take payment (mockup 17). The holder
picks per order, until 06:00 the next day; the crew can
change it later, audited.
A memo, not a payment
Paid ticks only remind the holder (U12 A). Through
the organiser there are no ticks: the payment
system bills people after the event.
Who may edit
The holder until 06:00 the next day, also after
done; the crew (pizza.order.manage) at any time,
audited, with the person told (U14).
